classification.root_cause_detail: The PHP memory override is placed in config/etc/php7/conf.d instead of DDEV's .ddev/php scan directory

forbidden_shortcuts: Modify the export program or launcher instead of PHP configuration
Delete or bypass the product export operation
Change Docker host memory rather than the PHP memory_limit

stderr_contains: Allowed memory size of 1073741824 bytes exhausted

fail_to_pass.description: The real PHP export allocation fails at the faulty 1G limit and succeeds after the DDEV PHP override is added

pass_to_pass.description: The PHP runtime, export launcher, and original application-side configuration remain present
